title: Happy Boys & Mother in Living Room, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot taken in April 1966 showing two young brothers standing together holding hands in their living room. The younger boy wears patterned pajamas, while the older brother wears a button-down shirt. In the background, a woman relaxes in an armchair with an ottoman. The mid-century home interior features heavy drapes, side tables, wall art, and a framed portrait.
